Three of the 11 searchable contracts mention arbitration:

- Acme_MSA.pdf, §14.2
- Brightline_SOW.docx, §9
- Northwind_NDA.pdf, §11

The other eight readable files have no mention. Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf is a scanned image with no extractable text, so I couldn't search it. It needs OCR or a manual read before you can rule it out.
